request.question:
Which ten non-test functions or methods are called from the most call sites in non-test code?

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string), call_sites (integer).
Return every requested field using exactly its specified column alias. Preserve complete case-sensitive repository-relative paths and symbol IDs; do not substitute display names. Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text. These questions concern a static map of open-source Python code. After executing SQL, describe the returned rows and query assumptions. Questions asking which files, modules or symbols mean distinct identities, not one repeated row per matching import or call occurrence; preserve occurrence counts only when requested. Caller/callee graph questions include methods as well as standalone functions unless a symbol kind is explicitly restricted. Use files.is_test for test-file classification; test_links describe associations, not the complete set of test files. Use DOUBLE or DECIMAL, rather than single-precision REAL, for percentage calculations.
Return both the symbol ID and its direct call-site count. Order by call_sites descending, then symbol_id ascending.

events.sql: SELECT callee.symbol_id AS symbol_id, CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) AS call_sites FROM auto_ontology_code.code.calls AS c JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS callee ON c.callee_symbol_id = callee.symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS callee_file ON callee.file_id = callee_file.file_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS caller ON c.caller_symbol_id = caller.symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS caller_file ON caller.file_id = caller_file.file_id WHERE c.call_kind = 'direct' AND callee_file.is_test = FALSE AND caller_file.is_test = FALSE AND callee.kind IN ('function', 'method') GROUP BY callee.symbol_id ORDER BY call_sites DESC, symbol_id ASC LIMIT 10;

gold_sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id, COUNT(*) AS call_sites
FROM code.calls c
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
JOIN code.symbols cs ON cs.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = cs.file_id
WHERE c.call_kind = 'direct'
  AND s.kind IN ('function', 'method')
  AND NOT f.is_test AND NOT cf.is_test
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
ORDER BY call_sites DESC, s.symbol_id
LIMIT 10;
